# mongophp-mongodb-readonly-dtos-partial-cursor-by-table

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories and services with the MongoDB PHP library, in PHP 8.4. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (readonly classes); updates take an array of the fields that change.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages after a key (cursor).

## Layout

```text
src/Database.php             opens the database DATABASE_URL names
src/Db.php                   a database and the session of its transaction
src/Documents.php            values as MongoDB stores them, what changed, and the rules of nested documents
src/UnitOfWork.php           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/Tables/<Table>/          entity, repositories and service of each table
tests/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json           what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
composer install
TEST_DATABASE_URL="mongodb://localhost:27017/app" vendor/bin/phpunit   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A page of a list read with a cursor: the rows after a key, and the key to read the next page from (null on the last page).
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class CursorPage
{
    /**
     * @param list<T> $items
     * @param list<mixed>|null $next
     */
    public function __construct(public array $items, public ?array $next)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The same page with every row turned into something else.
     *
     * @template R
     * @param callable(T): R $mapper
     * @return CursorPage<R>
     */
    public function map(callable $mapper): self
    {
        return new self(array_map($mapper, $this->items), $this->next);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use MongoDB\Client;

/** The MongoDB database DATABASE_URL names. It creates no collection and no index: the database already exists. */
final class Database
{
    public const DEFAULT_URL = 'mongodb://localhost:27017/app';

    /** The URL of DATABASE_URL, or the default one. */
    public static function url(): string
    {
        $url = getenv('DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : self::DEFAULT_URL;
    }

    /** The name of the database a URL names. */
    public static function name(string $url): string
    {
        if (preg_match('#^mongodb(?:\+srv)?://[^/]+/([^?]+)#', $url, $found) !== 1) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The URL names no database');
        }
        return rawurldecode($found[1]);
    }

    /** A Db over the database at $url (DATABASE_URL when null), one per unit of work; the driver keeps the connections. */
    public static function open(?string $url = null): Db
    {
        $url ??= self::url();
        return new Db((new Client($url))->selectDatabase(self::name($url)));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use MongoDB\Collection;
use MongoDB\Driver\Exception\BulkWriteException;
use MongoDB\Driver\Exception\CommandException;
use MongoDB\Driver\Exception\InvalidArgumentException;
use MongoDB\Driver\Session;
use MongoDB\Operation\FindOneAndUpdate;

/** A database and the session of its transaction, when there is one (MongoDB has them on replica sets only). A refused write is a ConflictException. */
final class Db
{
    private ?Session $session = null;

    public function __construct(public readonly \MongoDB\Database $database)
    {
    }

    public function inTransaction(): bool
    {
        return $this->session !== null;
    }

    public function begin(): void
    {
        $this->session = $this->database->getManager()->startSession();
        $this->session->startTransaction();
    }

    public function commit(): void
    {
        $this->session?->commitTransaction();
        $this->session = null;
    }

    public function rollBack(): void
    {
        if ($this->session?->isInTransaction()) {
            $this->session->abortTransaction();
        }
        $this->session = null;
    }

    public function collection(string $name): Collection
    {
        return $this->database->selectCollection($name, ['typeMap' => ['root' => 'array', 'document' => 'array', 'array' => 'array']]);
    }

    /**
     * The documents of a collection.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $filter
     * @param array<string, mixed> $options
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function find(string $collection, array $filter, array $options = []): array
    {
        return $this->collection($collection)->find($filter, $this->options($options))->toArray();
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $filter */
    public function count(string $collection, array $filter): int
    {
        return $this->collection($collection)->countDocuments($filter, $this->options());
    }

    /** @param callable(): array<string, mixed> $document */
    public function insert(string $entity, string $collection, callable $document): void
    {
        $this->write($entity, fn () => $this->collection($collection)->insertOne($document(), $this->options()));
    }

    /**
     * Changes one document; inside write().
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $filter
     * @param array<string, mixed> $change
     */
    public function update(string $collection, array $filter, array $change): void
    {
        $this->collection($collection)->updateOne($filter, $change, $this->options());
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $filter */
    public function delete(string $entity, string $collection, array $filter): void
    {
        $this->write($entity, fn () => $this->collection($collection)->deleteOne($filter, $this->options()));
    }

    /**
     * Changes one document where it is, and gives it as it is then; null when there is none.
     *
     * @param callable(): array{array<string, mixed>, array<mixed>} $change its filter and its change
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function change(string $entity, string $collection, callable $change): ?array
    {
        return $this->write($entity, fn () => $this->collection($collection)->findOneAndUpdate(
            ...[...$change(), $this->options(['returnDocument' => FindOneAndUpdate::RETURN_DOCUMENT_AFTER])],
        ));
    }

    /** Runs a write: a repeated value, or one the validator of the collection does not take, is a ConflictException; a text that is no identifier or number, a ValidationFailedException. */
    public function write(string $entity, callable $work): mixed
    {
        try {
            return $work();
        } catch (BulkWriteException|CommandException $error) {
            $codes = [$error->getCode()];
            if ($error instanceof BulkWriteException) {
                foreach ($error->getWriteResult()->getWriteErrors() as $refusal) {
                    $codes[] = $refusal->getCode();
                }
            }
            if (array_intersect($codes, [11000, 121]) === []) {
                throw $error;
            }
            throw new ConflictException($entity, 'the database refused the change: ' . $error->getMessage());
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $error) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException($entity, [new FieldError('', $error->getMessage())]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $options
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function options(array $options = []): array
    {
        return $this->session === null ? $options : [...$options, 'session' => $this->session];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use App\Errors\FieldError;
use MongoDB\BSON\Binary;
use MongoDB\BSON\Decimal128;
use MongoDB\BSON\Document;
use MongoDB\BSON\Int64;
use MongoDB\BSON\ObjectId;
use MongoDB\BSON\UTCDateTime;

/** Values as MongoDB stores them and as PHP has them, what changed in a document, and the rules of the documents inside others. */
final class Documents
{
    /** Whether a text is an identifier (an ObjectId). */
    public static function isId(mixed $value): bool
    {
        return is_string($value) && preg_match('/^[0-9a-f]{24}$/iD', $value) === 1;
    }

    /** A value as MongoDB stores it, by its shape: a kind, the `items` of a list or the `fields` of a document. What no shape names stays as it is. */
    public static function toBson(mixed $value, string|array|null $shape): mixed
    {
        if ($value === null || $shape === null) {
            return $value;
        }
        if (is_array($shape)) {
            if (!is_array($value)) {
                return $value;
            }
            if (isset($shape['items'])) {
                return array_map(fn (mixed $item) => self::toBson($item, $shape['items']), array_values($value));
            }
            $document = [];
            foreach ($value as $name => $item) {
                $known = array_key_exists($name, $shape['fields']);
                // A field without a value is left out
                if (!$known || $item !== null) {
                    $document[$name] = $known ? self::toBson($item, $shape['fields'][$name]) : $item;
                }
            }
            // An empty array would be a list
            return $document === [] ? new \stdClass() : $document;
        }
        return match ($shape) {
            'objectId' => $value instanceof ObjectId ? $value : new ObjectId((string) $value),
            'decimal' => $value instanceof Decimal128 ? $value : new Decimal128((string) $value),
            'uuid' => $value instanceof Binary ? $value : new Binary((string) hex2bin(str_replace('-', '', $value)), Binary::TYPE_UUID),
            'binary' => $value instanceof Binary ? $value : new Binary($value, Binary::TYPE_GENERIC),
            'datetime' => $value instanceof \DateTimeInterface ? new UTCDateTime($value) : $value,
            'long' => is_int($value) ? new Int64($value) : $value,
            'double' => is_int($value) ? (float) $value : $value,
            default => $value,
        };
    }

    /** A value of MongoDB as PHP has it, by its shape. */
    public static function fromBson(mixed $value, string|array|null $shape): mixed
    {
        if (is_array($shape) && is_array($value)) {
            if (isset($shape['items'])) {
                return array_map(fn (mixed $item) => self::fromBson($item, $shape['items']), array_values($value));
            }
            foreach ($value as $name => $item) {
                $value[$name] = self::fromBson($item, $shape['fields'][$name] ?? null);
            }
            return $value;
        }
        if ($value === null || $shape === null) {
            return $value;
        }
        return match (true) {
            $value instanceof ObjectId, $value instanceof Decimal128 => (string) $value,
            $value instanceof UTCDateTime => \DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($value->toDateTime()),
            $value instanceof Binary => $shape === 'uuid' ? vsprintf('%s%s-%s-%s-%s-%s%s%s', str_split(bin2hex($value->getData()), 4)) : $value->getData(),
            $value instanceof Int64 => (int) (string) $value,
            $shape === 'double' && is_int($value) => (float) $value,
            $shape === 'int' && is_float($value), $shape === 'long' && is_float($value) => (int) $value,
            $shape === 'decimal' => (string) $value,
            default => $value,
        };
    }

    /**
     * The update that takes a document from what it was to what it is: only the fields that differ, and inside a nested document only its own.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $before
     * @param array<string, mixed> $now
     * @param list<string> $fields
     * @return array<string, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function changes(array $before, array $now, array $fields): array
    {
        $changes = ['$set' => [], '$unset' => []];
        foreach ($fields as $field) {
            self::compare('', $field, $before, $now, $changes);
        }
        return array_filter($changes, fn (array $items) => $items !== []);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<mixed> $before
     * @param array<mixed> $now
     * @param array<string, array<string, mixed>> $changes
     */
    private static function compare(string $path, int|string $field, array $before, array $now, array &$changes): void
    {
        $old = $before[$field] ?? null;
        $current = $now[$field] ?? null;
        $bytes = fn (mixed $value) => (string) Document::fromPHP(['value' => $value]);
        if ($bytes($old) === $bytes($current)) {
            return;
        }
        $name = $path . $field;
        if ($current === null) {
            $changes['$unset'][$name] = '';
        } elseif (is_array($old) && is_array($current) && !array_is_list($old) && !array_is_list($current)) {
            foreach (array_keys($old + $current) as $item) {
                self::compare($name . '.', $item, $old, $current, $changes);
            }
        } else {
            $changes['$set'][$name] = $current;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Gives an identifier to the documents of a list that have none: MongoDB numbers only whole documents.
     *
     * @param list<array<string, mixed>>|null $items
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>|null
     */
    public static function identify(?array $items): ?array
    {
        return $items === null ? null : array_map(fn (mixed $item) => is_array($item) && !isset($item['_id']) ? [...$item, '_id' => (string) new ObjectId()] : $item, array_values($items));
    }

    /**
     * What a value does not follow of its rule, each with the path of its field (`lines.0.quantity`). Fields the rules do not name are left alone.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $rule
     * @return list<FieldError>
     */
    public static function problems(mixed $value, array $rule, string $path): array
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return isset($rule['required']) ? [new FieldError($path, 'is required')] : [];
        }
        $errors = [];
        if (isset($rule['items'])) {
            if (!is_array($value) || !array_is_list($value)) {
                return [new FieldError($path, 'must be a list')];
            }
            foreach ($value as $index => $item) {
                $errors = [...$errors, ...self::problems($item, [...$rule['items'], 'required' => true], "{$path}.{$index}")];
            }
        }
        if (isset($rule['fields'])) {
            if (!is_array($value) || ($value !== [] && array_is_list($value))) {
                return [new FieldError($path, 'must be a document')];
            }
            foreach ($rule['fields'] as $name => $field) {
                $errors = [...$errors, ...self::problems($value[$name] ?? null, $field, "{$path}.{$name}")];
            }
        }
        if (isset($rule['values']) && !in_array($value, $rule['values'])) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError($path, 'must be one of: ' . implode(', ', $rule['values']));
        }
        $limits = [
            'min' => ['>=', fn (float $limit) => (float) $value >= $limit],
            'above' => ['>', fn (float $limit) => (float) $value > $limit],
            'max' => ['<=', fn (float $limit) => (float) $value <= $limit],
            'below' => ['<', fn (float $limit) => (float) $value < $limit],
        ];
        foreach ($limits as $name => [$sign, $fits]) {
            if (isset($rule[$name]) && !$fits((float) $rule[$name])) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError($path, "must be {$sign} {$rule[$name]}");
            }
        }
        if (isset($rule['minLength']) && mb_strlen((string) $value) < $rule['minLength']) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError($path, "must have >= {$rule['minLength']} characters");
        }
        if (isset($rule['maxLength']) && mb_strlen((string) $value) > $rule['maxLength']) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError($path, "is longer than {$rule['maxLength']} characters");
        }
        return $errors;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use App\Tables\Countries\CountryRepository;
use App\Tables\Countries\MongoCountryRepository;
use App\Tables\Customers\CustomerRepository;
use App\Tables\Customers\MongoCustomerRepository;
use App\Tables\Orders\OrderRepository;
use App\Tables\Orders\MongoOrderRepository;
use App\Tables\Products\ProductRepository;
use App\Tables\Products\MongoProductRepository;

/** The repositories over one Db, and its transaction: MongoDB has them on replica sets only. */
final class MongoUnitOfWork implements UnitOfWork
{
    public readonly CustomerRepository $customers;
    public readonly ProductRepository $products;
    public readonly OrderRepository $orders;
    public readonly CountryRepository $countries;

    public function __construct(public readonly Db $db)
    {
        $this->customers = new MongoCustomerRepository($db);
        $this->products = new MongoProductRepository($db);
        $this->orders = new MongoOrderRepository($db);
        $this->countries = new MongoCountryRepository($db);
    }

    public function transaction(callable $work): mixed
    {
        // Joins the transaction already open
        if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
            return $work($this);
        }
        $this->db->begin();
        try {
            $result = $work($this);
            $this->db->commit();
            return $result;
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            $this->db->rollBack();
            throw $error;
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tables\Countries;

use App\Common\CursorPage;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on countries. Each write runs in its own transaction. */
final class CountryService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "countries" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Country $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['documentId'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('documentId', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('_id', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['id'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('id', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('id', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['name'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('name', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('name', 'is required');
            }
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Country', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Values that must be unique are not taken by another row.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function checkUnique(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Country $current): void
    {
        $id = array_key_exists('id', $values) ? $values['id'] : $current?->id;
        if ($id !== null) {
            $other = $uow->countries->findById($id);
            if ($other !== null && ($current === null || $other->documentId != $current->documentId)) {
                throw new ConflictException('Country', 'id is already taken', ['id']);
            }
        }
    }

    /**

namespace App\Tables\Countries;

use App\Common\CursorPage;

use App\Documents;

/** Keeps countries rows in the database, through the MongoDB library. A write joins the transaction already open, or is committed at once. */
final class MongoCountryRepository implements CountryRepository
{
    /** What each field is in MongoDB, when it is not what PHP has */
    private const SHAPE = [
        '_id' => null,
        'id' => 'double',
        'name' => null,
    ];

    /** The fields a change may write */
    private const FIELDS = ['id', 'name'];

    /**
     * The document each entity was read from: a change writes only the fields that differ.
     *
     * @var \WeakMap<Country, array<string, mixed>>|null
     */
    private static ?\WeakMap $read = null;

    public function __construct(private readonly Db $db)
    {
    }

    public function findByDocumentId(string $documentId): ?Country
    {
        return array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('countries', ['_id' => $documentId], ['limit' => 1]))[0] ?? null;
    }

    public function list(?array $after, int $limit): CursorPage
    {
        $filter = [];
        if ($after !== null) {
            $filter['_id'] = ['$gt' => $after[0]];
        }
        $rows = array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('countries', $filter, ['sort' => ['_id' => 1], 'limit' => $limit + 1]));
        $items = array_slice($rows, 0, $limit);
        return new CursorPage($items, count($rows) > $limit ? [$items[$limit - 1]->documentId] : null);
    }

    public function findById(float $id): ?Country
    {
        return array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('countries', ['id' => Documents::toBson($id, 'double')], ['limit' => 1]))[0] ?? null;
    }

    public function insert(Country $entity): Country
    {
        $this->db->insert('Country', 'countries', fn () => self::document($entity));
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    public function update(Country $entity): Country
    {
        $this->db->write('Country', function () use ($entity): void {
            $now = self::document($entity);
            $changes = Documents::changes(self::$read[$entity] ?? [], $now, self::FIELDS);
            if ($changes === []) {
                return;
            }
            $this->db->update('countries', ['_id' => $now['_id']], $changes);
        });
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    public function delete(Country $entity): void
    {
        $this->db->delete('Country', 'countries', ['_id' => $entity->documentId]);
    }

    /**
     * The Country of a document.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $document
     */
    private static function entity(array $document): Country
    {
        $entity = new Country();
        $entity->documentId = Documents::fromBson($document['_id'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['_id']);
        $entity->id = Documents::fromBson($document['id'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['id']);
        $entity->name = Documents::fromBson($document['name'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['name']);
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    /**
     * The document of a Country: what is null is left out.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function document(Country $entity): array
    {
        return array_filter([
            '_id' => Documents::toBson($entity->documentId, self::SHAPE['_id']),
            'id' => Documents::toBson($entity->id, self::SHAPE['id']),
            'name' => Documents::toBson($entity->name, self::SHAPE['name']),
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
    }

    /** The same entity, with what it is stored as kept to tell its changes. */
    private static function loaded(Country $entity): Country
    {
        self::$read ??= new \WeakMap();
        self::$read[$entity] = self::document($entity);
        return $entity;
    }
}

     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Customer $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['email'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('email', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('email', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 120) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('email', 'is longer than 120 characters');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['name'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('name', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('name', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (!(mb_strlen((string) $value) >= 2)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('name', 'must have >= 2 characters');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['level'] ?? null;
        if ($value !== null) {
            if (!in_array((string) $value, ['basic', 'gold'], true)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('level', 'must be one of: basic, gold');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['address'] ?? null;
        if ($value !== null) {
            $errors = [...$errors, ...Documents::problems($value, ['fields' => ['street' => ['required' => true], 'city' => ['required' => true], 'zip code' => [], 'location' => ['fields' => ['type' => ['values' => ['Point']], 'coordinates' => ['items' => []]]]]], 'address')];
        }
        $value = $values['tags'] ?? null;
        if ($value !== null) {
            $errors = [...$errors, ...Documents::problems($value, ['items' => []], 'tags')];
        }
        $value = $values['preferences'] ?? null;
        if ($value !== null) {
            $errors = [...$errors, ...Documents::problems($value, ['fields' => ['theme' => [], 'newsletter' => []]], 'preferences')];
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Customer', $errors);
        }

    private static function checkUnique(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Customer $current): void
    {
        $email = array_key_exists('email', $values) ? $values['email'] : $current?->email;
        if ($email !== null) {
            $other = $uow->customers->findByEmail($email);
            if ($other !== null && ($current === null || $other->id != $current->id)) {
                throw new ConflictException('Customer', 'email is already taken', ['email']);
            }

     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Customer $current): void

    {

    private static function read(Customer $entity): CustomerRead
    {
        return new CustomerRead(

    }

     * Changes the given values of a Customer.
     *
     * @param array{email?: string, name?: string, passwordHash?: string|null, active?: bool|null, level?: string|null, address?: array|null, tags?: array|null, preferences?: array|null, extra?: mixed, deletedAt?: \DateTimeImmutable|null, updatedAt?: \DateTimeImmutable|null} $changes

            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return self::read($uow->customers->update($current));
        });
    }

    public function deleteCustomer(string $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            if ($uow->orders->listByCustomer($current->id) !== []) {
                throw new ConflictException('Customer', 'rows of orders still point to it', ['orders']);
            }
            $current->deletedAt = new \DateTimeImmutable();
            $uow->customers->update($current);
        });
    }

    /** The Customer with this email, or null. */

    {
        $entity = $this->uow->customers->findByEmail($email);
        return $entity === null ? null : self::read($entity);
    }

    {
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $tag): CustomerRead {
            self::find($uow, $id);
            return self::read($uow->customers->addTag($id, $tag) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Customer', $id));

    }

    public function removeTag(string $id, string $tag): CustomerRead
    {

            return self::read($uow->customers->removeTag($id, $tag) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Customer', $id));

    }

namespace App\Tables\Orders;

use App\Common\CursorPage;
use App\Documents;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on orders. Each write runs in its own transaction. */
final class OrderService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "orders" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Order $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['number'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('number', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('number', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['year'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('year', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('year', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['customer'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('customer', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('customer', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['lines'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('lines', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('lines', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            $errors = [...$errors, ...Documents::problems($value, ['items' => ['fields' => ['product' => ['required' => true], 'quantity' => ['required' => true, 'min' => 1], 'price' => ['required' => true], 'status' => ['values' => ['pending', 'sent']]]]], 'lines')];
        }
        $value = $values['notes'] ?? null;
        if ($value !== null) {
            $errors = [...$errors, ...Documents::problems($value, ['items' => ['fields' => ['text' => [], 'at' => []]]], 'notes')];
        }
        $customer = array_key_exists('customer', $values) ? $values['customer'] : $current?->customer;
        if ($customer !== null && $uow->customers->findById($customer) === null) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError('customer', 'no Customer has this key');
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Order', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Values that must be unique are not taken by another row.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function checkUnique(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Order $current): void
    {
        $year = array_key_exists('year', $values) ? $values['year'] : $current?->year;
        $number = array_key_exists('number', $values) ? $values['number'] : $current?->number;
        if ($year !== null && $number !== null) {
            $other = $uow->orders->findByYearAndNumber($year, $number);
            if ($other !== null && ($current === null || $other->id != $current->id)) {
                throw new ConflictException('Order', 'year, number is already taken', ['year', 'number']);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Order $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
        self::checkUnique($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Order $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('number', $values)) {
            $entity->number = $values['number'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('year', $values)) {
            $entity->year = $values['year'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('customer', $values)) {
            $entity->customer = $values['customer'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('lines', $values)) {
            $entity->lines = $values['lines'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('notes', $values)) {
            $entity->notes = $values['notes'];
        }
    }

    /** The Order with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, string $id): Order
    {
        return $uow->orders->findById($id) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Order', $id);
    }

    /** The Order as services return it. */
    private static function read(Order $entity): OrderRead
    {
        return new OrderRead(
            id: $entity->id,
            number: $entity->number,
            year: $entity->year,
            customer: $entity->customer,
            lines: $entity->lines,
            notes: $entity->notes,
            placedAt: $entity->placedAt,
        );
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field: only the fields of the table that can change.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $changes
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(array $changes): array
    {
        return array_intersect_key($changes, array_flip(['number', 'year', 'customer', 'lines', 'notes']));
    }

    /** Stores a new Order after checking it. */
    public function createOrder(OrderCreate $data): OrderRead
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'number' => $data->number,
            'year' => $data->year,
            'customer' => $data->customer,
            'lines' => $data->lines,
            'notes' => $data->notes,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values): OrderRead {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            $entity = new Order();
            self::apply($entity, $values);
            return self::read($uow->orders->insert($entity));
        });
    }

    /** The Order with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getOrder(string $id): OrderRead
    {
        return self::read(self::find($this->uow, $id));
    }

    /**
     * A page of orders after the key $after (null for the first page), by primary key.
     *
     * @param list<mixed>|null $after
     * @return CursorPage<OrderRead>
     */
    public function listOrders(?array $after, int $limit): CursorPage
    {
        return $this->uow->orders->list($after, $limit)->map(self::read(...));
    }

    /**
     * Changes the given values of a Order.
     *
     * @param array{number?: float, year?: float, customer?: string, lines?: array, notes?: array|null} $changes
     */
    public function updateOrder(string $id, array $changes): OrderRead
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): OrderRead {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return self::read($uow->orders->update($current));
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a Order. */
    public function deleteOrder(string $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            $uow->orders->delete($current);
        });
    }

    /** The Order with this year and number, or null. */
    public function findOrderByYearAndNumber(float $year, float $number): ?OrderRead
    {
        $entity = $this->uow->orders->findByYearAndNumber($year, $number);
        return $entity === null ? null : self::read($entity);
    }

    /**
     * The orders with this customer.
     *
     * @return list<OrderRead>
     */
    public function listOrdersByCustomer(string $customer): array
    {
        return array_map(self::read(...), $this->uow->orders->listByCustomer($customer));
    }

    /** Adds an item to lines. */
    public function addLine(string $id, array $line): OrderRead
    {
        $errors = Documents::problems($line, ['fields' => ['product' => ['required' => true], 'quantity' => ['required' => true, 'min' => 1], 'price' => ['required' => true], 'status' => ['values' => ['pending', 'sent']]]], 'lines');
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Order', $errors);
        }
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $line): OrderRead {
            self::find($uow, $id);
            return self::read($uow->orders->addLine($id, $line) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Order', $id));
        });
    }

    /** Removes an item from lines, by its identifier. */
    public function removeLine(string $id, string $lineId): OrderRead
    {
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $lineId): OrderRead {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            if (!in_array($lineId, array_column(($current->lines ?? []), '_id'), true)) {
                throw new NotFoundException('Line', $lineId);
            }
            return self::read($uow->orders->removeLine($id, $lineId) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Order', $id));
        });
    }

    /** Adds an item to notes. */
    public function addNote(string $id, array $note): OrderRead
    {
        $errors = Documents::problems($note, ['fields' => ['text' => [], 'at' => []]], 'notes');
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Order', $errors);
        }
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $note): OrderRead {
            self::find($uow, $id);
            return self::read($uow->orders->addNote($id, $note) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Order', $id));
        });
    }

    /** Removes an item from notes, by its identifier. */
    public function removeNote(string $id, string $noteId): OrderRead
    {
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $noteId): OrderRead {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            if (!in_array($noteId, array_column(($current->notes ?? []), '_id'), true)) {
                throw new NotFoundException('Note', $noteId);
            }
            return self::read($uow->orders->removeNote($id, $noteId) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Order', $id));
        });
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tables\Products;

use App\Common\CursorPage;

/** Keeps products rows in memory, for tests and for trying the services without a database. */
final class MemoryProductRepository implements ProductRepository
{
    /** @var array<string, Product> */
    private array $rows = [];

    /**
     * The key of a row, as a list of its key values.
     *
     * @return list<mixed>
     */
    private static function keyOf(Product $row): array
    {
        return [$row->id];
    }

    private static function keyText(Product $row): string
    {
        return serialize(array_map(fn (mixed $value) => $value instanceof \DateTimeInterface ? $value->format('Y-m-d H:i:s.u P') : $value, self::keyOf($row)));
    }

    /**
     * The rows reads can see, by primary key.
     *
     * @return list<Product>
     */
    private function visible(): array
    {
        $rows = array_values(array_filter($this->rows, fn (Product $row) => true));
        usort($rows, fn (Product $a, Product $b) => self::keyOf($a) <=> self::keyOf($b));
        return $rows;
    }

    public function findById(string $id): ?Product
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->id == $id) {
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function list(?array $after, int $limit): CursorPage
    {
        $rows = array_values(array_filter($this->visible(), fn (Product $row) => $after === null || (self::keyOf($row) <=> $after) > 0));
        $items = array_slice($rows, 0, $limit);
        return new CursorPage($items, count($rows) > $limit ? self::keyOf($items[count($items) - 1]) : null);
    }

    public function findBySku(string $sku): ?Product
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->sku == $sku) {
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function findAllByTitle(string $title): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter($this->visible(), fn (Product $row) => $row->title == $title));
    }

    public function insert(Product $entity): Product
    {
        $entity->id ??= (string) new \MongoDB\BSON\ObjectId();
        $entity->stock ??= 0.0;
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(Product $entity): Product
    {
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(Product $entity): void
    {
        unset($this->rows[self::keyText($entity)]);
    }

    public function addRelated(string $id, string $related): ?Product
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->id == $id) {
                $row->related = [...($row->related ?? []), $related];
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function removeRelated(string $id, string $related): ?Product
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->id == $id) {
                $row->related = array_values(array_filter($row->related ?? [], fn (mixed $candidate) => $candidate !== $related));
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tables\Products;

use App\Common\CursorPage;
use App\Db;
use App\Documents;

/** Keeps products rows in the database, through the MongoDB library. A write joins the transaction already open, or is committed at once. */
final class MongoProductRepository implements ProductRepository
{
    /** What each field is in MongoDB, when it is not what PHP has */
    private const SHAPE = [
        '_id' => 'objectId',
        'sku' => null,
        'title' => null,
        'price' => 'decimal',
        'stock' => 'double',
        'reference' => 'uuid',
        'picture' => 'binary',
        'related' => ['items' => 'objectId'],
    ];

    /** The fields a change may write */
    private const FIELDS = ['sku', 'title', 'price', 'stock', 'reference', 'picture', 'related'];

    /**
     * The document each entity was read from: a change writes only the fields that differ.
     *
     * @var \WeakMap<Product, array<string, mixed>>|null
     */
    private static ?\WeakMap $read = null;

    public function __construct(private readonly Db $db)
    {
    }

    public function findById(string $id): ?Product
    {
        if (!Documents::isId($id)) {
            return null;
        }
        return array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('products', ['_id' => Documents::toBson($id, 'objectId')], ['limit' => 1]))[0] ?? null;
    }

    public function list(?array $after, int $limit): CursorPage
    {
        $filter = [];
        if ($after !== null) {
            $filter['_id'] = ['$gt' => Documents::toBson($after[0], 'objectId')];
        }
        $rows = array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('products', $filter, ['sort' => ['_id' => 1], 'limit' => $limit + 1]));
        $items = array_slice($rows, 0, $limit);
        return new CursorPage($items, count($rows) > $limit ? [$items[$limit - 1]->id] : null);
    }

    public function findBySku(string $sku): ?Product
    {
        return array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('products', ['sku' => $sku], ['limit' => 1]))[0] ?? null;
    }

    public function findAllByTitle(string $title): array
    {
        return array_map(self::entity(...), $this->db->find('products', ['title' => $title], ['sort' => ['_id' => 1]]));
    }

    public function insert(Product $entity): Product
    {
        $entity->id ??= (string) new \MongoDB\BSON\ObjectId();
        $entity->stock ??= 0.0;
        $this->db->insert('Product', 'products', fn () => self::document($entity));
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    public function update(Product $entity): Product
    {
        $this->db->write('Product', function () use ($entity): void {
            $now = self::document($entity);
            $changes = Documents::changes(self::$read[$entity] ?? [], $now, self::FIELDS);
            if ($changes === []) {
                return;
            }
            $this->db->update('products', ['_id' => $now['_id']], $changes);
        });
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    public function delete(Product $entity): void
    {
        $this->db->delete('Product', 'products', ['_id' => Documents::toBson($entity->id, 'objectId')]);
    }

    public function addRelated(string $id, string $related): ?Product
    {
        if (!Documents::isId($id)) {
            return null;
        }
        $document = $this->db->change('Product', 'products', fn () => [['_id' => Documents::toBson($id, 'objectId')], ['$push' => ['related' => Documents::toBson($related, 'objectId')]]]);
        return $document === null ? null : self::entity($document);
    }

    public function removeRelated(string $id, string $related): ?Product
    {
        if (!Documents::isId($id)) {
            return null;
        }
        $document = $this->db->change('Product', 'products', fn () => [['_id' => Documents::toBson($id, 'objectId')], ['$pull' => ['related' => Documents::toBson($related, 'objectId')]]]);
        return $document === null ? null : self::entity($document);
    }

    /**
     * The Product of a document.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $document
     */
    private static function entity(array $document): Product
    {
        $entity = new Product();
        $entity->id = Documents::fromBson($document['_id'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['_id']);
        $entity->sku = Documents::fromBson($document['sku'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['sku']);
        $entity->title = Documents::fromBson($document['title'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['title']);
        $entity->price = Documents::fromBson($document['price'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['price']);
        $entity->stock = Documents::fromBson($document['stock'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['stock']);
        $entity->reference = Documents::fromBson($document['reference'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['reference']);
        $entity->picture = Documents::fromBson($document['picture'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['picture']);
        $entity->related = Documents::fromBson($document['related'] ?? null, self::SHAPE['related']);
        return self::loaded($entity);
    }

    /**
     * The document of a Product: what is null is left out.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function document(Product $entity): array
    {
        return array_filter([
            '_id' => Documents::toBson($entity->id, self::SHAPE['_id']),
            'sku' => Documents::toBson($entity->sku, self::SHAPE['sku']),
            'title' => Documents::toBson($entity->title, self::SHAPE['title']),
            'price' => Documents::toBson($entity->price, self::SHAPE['price']),
            'stock' => Documents::toBson($entity->stock, self::SHAPE['stock']),
            'reference' => Documents::toBson($entity->reference, self::SHAPE['reference']),
            'picture' => Documents::toBson($entity->picture, self::SHAPE['picture']),
            'related' => Documents::toBson($entity->related, self::SHAPE['related']),
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
    }

    /** The same entity, with what it is stored as kept to tell its changes. */
    private static function loaded(Product $entity): Product
    {
        self::$read ??= new \WeakMap();
        self::$read[$entity] = self::document($entity);
        return $entity;
    }
}

{
    /** The row with this primary key, or null. */

     * Rows with this title, by primary key.
     *
     * @return list<Product>
     */
    public function findAllByTitle(string $title): array;

    /** Stores a new row; the values the database fills are read back. */
    public function insert(Product $entity): Product;

    /** Stores the changes made to a row read from this repository. */
    public function update(Product $entity): Product;

    /** Removes a row read from this repository. */
    public function delete(Product $entity): void;

    /** Adds an item to related, and gives the row as it is then, if there is one. */
    public function addRelated(string $id, string $related): ?Product;

    /** Removes an item from related, and gives the row as it is then, if there is one. */
    public function removeRelated(string $id, string $related): ?Product;
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tables\Products;

use App\Common\CursorPage;
use App\Documents;
use App\Errors\ConflictException;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on products. Each write runs in its own transaction. */
final class ProductService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "products" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Product $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['sku'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('sku', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('sku', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['title'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('title', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('title', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['price'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('price', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('price', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['stock'] ?? null;
        if ($value !== null) {
            if (!((float) $value >= 0)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('stock', 'must be >= 0');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['related'] ?? null;
        if ($value !== null) {
            $errors = [...$errors, ...Documents::problems($value, ['items' => []], 'related')];
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Product', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Values that must be unique are not taken by another row.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function checkUnique(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Product $current): void
    {
        $sku = array_key_exists('sku', $values) ? $values['sku'] : $current?->sku;
        if ($sku !== null) {
            $other = $uow->products->findBySku($sku);
            if ($other !== null && ($current === null || $other->id != $current->id)) {
                throw new ConflictException('Product', 'sku is already taken', ['sku']);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Product $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
        self::checkUnique($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Product $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('sku', $values)) {
            $entity->sku = $values['sku'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('title', $values)) {
            $entity->title = $values['title'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('price', $values)) {
            $entity->price = $values['price'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('stock', $values)) {
            $entity->stock = $values['stock'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('reference', $values)) {
            $entity->reference = $values['reference'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('picture', $values)) {
            $entity->picture = $values['picture'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('related', $values)) {
            $entity->related = $values['related'];
        }
    }

    /** The Product with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, string $id): Product
    {
        return $uow->products->findById($id) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Product', $id);
    }

    /** The Product as services return it. */
    private static function read(Product $entity): ProductRead
    {
        return new ProductRead(
            id: $entity->id,
            sku: $entity->sku,
            title: $entity->title,
            price: $entity->price,
            stock: $entity->stock,
            reference: $entity->reference,
            picture: $entity->picture,
            related: $entity->related,
        );
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field: only the fields of the table that can change.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $changes
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(array $changes): array
    {
        return array_intersect_key($changes, array_flip(['sku', 'title', 'price', 'stock', 'reference', 'picture', 'related']));
    }

    /** Stores a new Product after checking it. */
    public function createProduct(ProductCreate $data): ProductRead
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'sku' => $data->sku,
            'title' => $data->title,
            'price' => $data->price,
            'stock' => $data->stock,
            'reference' => $data->reference,
            'picture' => $data->picture,
            'related' => $data->related,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values): ProductRead {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            $entity = new Product();
            self::apply($entity, $values);
            return self::read($uow->products->insert($entity));
        });
    }

    /** The Product with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getProduct(string $id): ProductRead
    {
        return self::read(self::find($this->uow, $id));
    }

    /**
     * A page of products after the key $after (null for the first page), by primary key.
     *
     * @param list<mixed>|null $after
     * @return CursorPage<ProductRead>
     */
    public function listProducts(?array $after, int $limit): CursorPage
    {
        return $this->uow->products->list($after, $limit)->map(self::read(...));
    }

    /**
     * Changes the given values of a Product.
     *
     * @param array{sku?: string, title?: string, price?: string, stock?: float|null, reference?: string|null, picture?: string|null, related?: array|null} $changes
     */
    public function updateProduct(string $id, array $changes): ProductRead
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): ProductRead {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return self::read($uow->products->update($current));
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a Product. */
    public function deleteProduct(string $id): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            $uow->products->delete($current);
        });
    }

    /** The Product with this sku, or null. */
    public function findProductBySku(string $sku): ?ProductRead
    {
        $entity = $this->uow->products->findBySku($sku);
        return $entity === null ? null : self::read($entity);
    }

    /** Adds an item to related. */
    public function addRelated(string $id, string $related): ProductRead
    {
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $related): ProductRead {
            self::find($uow, $id);
            return self::read($uow->products->addRelated($id, $related) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Product', $id));
        });
    }

    /** Removes an item from related, by its value. */
    public function removeRelated(string $id, string $related): ProductRead
    {
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $related): ProductRead {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            if (!in_array($related, ($current->related ?? []), true)) {
                throw new NotFoundException('Related', $related);
            }
            return self::read($uow->products->removeRelated($id, $related) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Product', $id));
        });
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Database;
use App\MongoUnitOfWork;

/** The test database: the MongoDB database TEST_DATABASE_URL names, with every collection created empty before every test. */
final class TestDatabase
{
    public static function url(): ?string
    {
        $url = getenv('TEST_DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : null;
    }

    /** The repositories over the test database, with its collections and their indexes created again. */
    public static function open(): MongoUnitOfWork
    {
        $db = Database::open(self::url() ?? throw new \RuntimeException('The database tests need a disposable MongoDB database (a replica set, for its transactions): set TEST_DATABASE_URL (it is emptied)'));
        $db->database->drop();
        $db->database->createCollection('customers');
        $db->database->createCollection('products');
        $db->database->createCollection('orders');
        $db->database->createCollection('countries');
        $db->collection('customers')->createIndex(['email' => 1], ['unique' => true]);
        $db->collection('products')->createIndex(['sku' => 1], ['unique' => true]);
        $db->collection('products')->createIndex(['title' => 1]);
        $db->collection('orders')->createIndex(['year' => 1, 'number' => 1], ['unique' => true]);
        $db->collection('orders')->createIndex(['customer' => 1]);
        $db->collection('countries')->createIndex(['id' => 1], ['unique' => true]);
        return new MongoUnitOfWork($db);
    }
}
